cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.

mechanism: A corrects incomplete answers as inadequate professional feedback to extract the truth B is cushioning.
confusable: General suspicion differs from probing specific omissions in each careful answer with expert standards.
comparison: Sibling audition feedback protects feelings; meeting minutes protect the proposal and conceal its replacement presenter.
seedUse: Keep the exact careful phrases as hooks for the next question rather than treating B as a generic evasive witness.
